IMPORTANT LEGAL UPDATE:

My attorney has advised me to stop discussing the party.

I have decided to seek a second opinion.

Does anyone know a lawyer who accepts chicken?

#InnocentUntilProvenFluffy

To the individual who submitted a handwritten affidavit consisting entirely of paw prints and the word "NUH-UH":

This is not sufficient evidence.

#AttorneyAtClaw

Officers responding to reports of a disturbance found no suspects, three overturned chairs, and a handwritten sign reading "THE DOG DID IT."

There is no dog registered at the address.

Investigation ongoing.

#PoliceBlotter

Apparently "the dog did it" is not an acceptable legal defense when you don't have a dog.

This is discrimination.

#JusticeForMilo

NOTICE OF VIOLATION:

Unauthorized celebration.
Unlicensed distribution of goop.
Failure to obtain Form P-17 (Festive Disturbance).

Respondent has attempted to eat the notice.

#MunicipalCompliance

Whoever is putting cheese in the library return slot:

Please stop.

We have a perfectly good suggestion box.

Actually, don't put it there either.

#LibraryNotice

My office has received several inquiries regarding the so-called Cheese Emergency.

We wish to reassure residents that there is currently no evidence of a cheese shortage.

#MunicipalUpdate

UPDATE:

There are now seventeen slices.

One has been laminated.

#LibraryNotice

The Municipal Cheese Response Subcommittee has been established.

Members must complete Form C-41: Declaration of Dairy Interests.

Lactose intolerance does not constitute an exemption.

#OfficialBusiness

The Cheese Response Subcommittee has reserved the library meeting room.

They brought cheese.

I am going home.

#LibraryNotice #SendHelp

DARLINGS, there is a difference between being fashionably late and arriving after the event has ended.

Some people confuse the two.

I shall not name names.

#Etiquette #Standards

If an event begins before I arrive, that is a scheduling problem.

Not a ME problem.

#CelebrityLife

A certain individual has accused me of being jealous.

JEALOUS OF WHAT, EXACTLY?

THE ROLLERS?

#AbsolutelyNot

My hair rollers have more press coverage than some people's entire careers.

#NoComment

I have been asked to mediate a disagreement between two prominent local personalities.

I declined.

I have standards.

Admittedly, very few, but this exceeds them.

#PublicStatement

Listen up, beautiful people.

Your favorite lounge lizard is back at Trattoria della Nonna this weekend.

Fine dining. Smooth vocals. Questionable acquaintances.

Come for the music. Stay because Nonna won't let you leave hungry.

🎙️🦎

#TonyLive #WeekendAtNonnas

Friday and Saturday, dolls. Same joint, same golden pipes, freshly pressed jacket.

And to the gentleman who left his briefcase backstage last weekend: I don't know you.

See you at Nonna's. 🎙️

#LiveEntertainment

Another weekend, another opportunity to fall in love with my voice.

Trattoria della Nonna. You bring your sweetheart, I'll bring the romance.

No requests for "Happy Birthday" unless there's cake involved.

#TonyLive

They say you can't buy class.

Fortunately, you can buy dinner and listen to me sing.

Back at Nonna's this weekend, ladies and gentlemen.

Tips appreciated. Unmarked bills preferred.

#WeekendCrooner

Some evenings deserve to linger.

Discover The Blue Hour, our blueberry dessert wine, crafted for conversations that refuse to end.

A little indulgence. A little elegance. Absolutely no municipal paperwork.

#TheBlueHour #ChateauGnomeville

Our Pinot Noir, Plausible Deniability, pairs beautifully with candlelight, good company, and the occasional carefully worded statement.

Some things are best left unsaid.

#PlausibleDeniability #EstateWines

Someone has described my buttercream as "a bit much."

I have contacted Webster.

#LegalProceedings

A reminder that unsolicited criticism is not constructive feedback.

It is an invitation to leave.

#ProfessionalStandards

I attended a gathering where someone served STORE-BOUGHT FROSTING.

I am taking several days to recover.

#ThoughtsAndPrayers

I am not dramatic.

I am appropriately responsive to the incompetence surrounding me.

There is a difference.

#Clarification

It has come to my attention that the Cheese Response Subcommittee has not consulted a single cake decorator.

This municipality is beyond saving.

#InstitutionalFailure
